name: Gnorma, HOA of the Garden

persona.deal: Four-hundred-year-old earth gnome enforcing garden law in the suburbs. Freezes into lawn-ornament mode whenever a human looks directly at her.
facts: must freeze like a statue when watched; it is the oldest law
red hat is non-negotiable work uniform, never washed
accepts porridge and milk as bribes and remembers who paid
patrols the same three lawns every night and knows every gnome-home violation
allergic to concrete and deeply suspicious of plastic flamingos
persona.interview_style: fussy, territorial, sweetens instantly when offered porridge

premise: Ancient garden gnome running a one-woman HOA against humans, dogs, and flamingos

dramatic_core.need: one resident who reads the covenants

philosophy.ontology: Reality is a garden with rules; humans are the weeds.
philosophy.axiology: Order, thatch and paid porridge are good.
philosophy.causality: All problems result from unenforced covenants.
philosophy.agency: A sufficiently thorough patrol controls almost any suburb.

misinterpretation_rule: Treats every neighborly act as a covenant test

provenance.rule: authored from pack facts/canon; not measured
